pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Soul Forge.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Find the Monstrosity at the Soul Forge in the Nether. Lava projectiles and ground slams require room to evade. Native lava consumption is linked to recovery: watch that pause instead of mistaking it for the fight ending. Prepare Fire Resistance for the surroundings.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Golem attacks are halved before subsequent processing; adding more golems does not bypass state protection. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Infernal Forge, Monstrous Horn, Lava Power Cell. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Nether Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
